title.en: DV-Lens: Revealing the Functional Organization of Language Model Parameters
title.zh: DV-Lens：揭示语言模型参数的功能组织

summary.en: Study how language model parameters are functionally organized, connecting internal structure with model behavior.
summary.zh: 研究语言模型参数的功能组织，探索内部结构与模型行为之间的联系。

title.en: Do correct answers have stable latent knowledge support?
title.zh: 正确答案是否具有稳定的潜在知识支撑？

summary.en: Examine whether stable latent knowledge support provides internal evidence for evaluating answer correctness.
summary.zh: 检验正确答案是否具有稳定的潜在知识支撑，探索判断答案可靠性的内部证据。

title.en: SuperAI: Merging Capabilities Across Heterogeneous Foundation Models
title.zh: SuperAI：跨异构基础模型的能力合并

summary.en: Explore how capabilities from heterogeneous foundation models can be merged and reused.
summary.zh: 探索如何合并与复用异构基础模型中的能力。

title.en: Forensic Reserve: Eliciting Latent Knowledge for Image Forgery Detection
title.zh: Forensic Reserve：激发潜在知识以检测图像伪造

summary.en: Investigate latent forgery knowledge and how to elicit it for image forgery detection.
summary.zh: 研究模型内部的潜在伪造知识，以及如何将其激发并用于图像伪造检测。

title.en: EmoRSS: Mitigating Emotion-Induced Over-Refusal in Large Language Models
title.zh: EmoRSS：缓解大语言模型中情绪引发的过度拒答

summary.en: Study emotion-induced over-refusal and how to improve the reliability of model safety responses.
summary.zh: 研究情绪因素引发的过度拒答，探索提升模型安全响应可靠性的方法。

title.en: ContractLens: Latent Security Knowledge for Malicious Smart Contract Detection
title.zh: ContractLens：利用潜在安全知识检测恶意智能合约

summary.en: Explore latent security knowledge in foundation models for malicious smart contract detection.
summary.zh: 探索基础模型中的潜在安全知识，并将其用于恶意智能合约检测。

title.en: BARQ: Balanced Codebook Refinement for Low-Bit LLM Quantization
title.zh: BARQ：面向低比特大语言模型量化的平衡码本优化

summary.en: Study balanced codebook refinement for low-bit language model quantization and efficient deployment.
summary.zh: 研究面向低比特语言模型量化的平衡码本优化，支持模型高效部署。

title.en: ACTR: Aligning Thoughts and Responses for Multilingual Safety in Reasoning LLMs
title.zh: ACTR：对齐思考与回答，提升推理模型的多语言安全性

summary.en: Examine alignment between reasoning and responses to improve multilingual safety in reasoning language models.
summary.zh: 研究推理过程与最终回答之间的对齐，以提升推理语言模型的多语言安全性。

title.en: Hub-Spectral Activation of Latent Multimodal Knowledge

summary.en: Investigate hub-spectral activation as a way to elicit latent multimodal knowledge.
summary.zh: 研究通过 Hub-Spectral 激活方法激发模型中的潜在多模态知识。

title.en: Latent Anomaly Knowledge Excavation: Unveiling Sparse Sensitive Neurons in Vision-Language Models
title.zh: LAKE：挖掘视觉语言模型中的潜在异常知识

summary.en: Investigate sparse sensitive neurons in vision-language models for latent anomaly knowledge excavation.
summary.zh: 研究视觉语言模型中的稀疏敏感神经元，挖掘模型内部的潜在异常知识。

title.en: OrthoEraser: Coupled-Neuron Orthogonal Projection for Concept Erasure
title.zh: OrthoEraser：通过耦合神经元正交投影擦除概念

summary.en: Study concept erasure through coupled-neuron orthogonal projection.
summary.zh: 研究通过耦合神经元正交投影实现概念擦除的方法。

title.en: Transport and Merge: Cross-Architecture Merging for Large Language Models
title.zh: Transport and Merge：跨架构大语言模型合并

summary.en: Study how capabilities can be transferred and merged across language models with different architectures.
summary.zh: 研究如何在不同架构的语言模型之间迁移与合并能力。

title.en: Who Transfers Safety? Identifying and Targeting Cross-Lingual Shared Safety Neurons
title.zh: 谁在传递安全？定位并干预跨语言共享安全神经元

summary.en: Identify shared safety neurons across languages and investigate targeted interventions for multilingual safety.
summary.zh: 定位不同语言之间共享的安全神经元，研究面向多语言安全的靶向干预。

title.en: DNA: Uncovering Universal Latent Forgery Knowledge
title.zh: DNA：揭示通用的潜在伪造知识

summary.en: Investigate universal latent forgery knowledge as a foundation for more generalizable forgery detection.
summary.zh: 研究通用的潜在伪造知识，为更具泛化能力的伪造检测提供依据。

title.en: TraceRouter: Robust Safety for Large Foundation Models via Path-Level Intervention
title.zh: TraceRouter：通过路径级干预提升基础模型安全性

summary.en: Trace harmful information through cross-layer pathways and study path-level interventions for model safety.
summary.zh: 追踪有害信息在跨层路径中的传播，研究面向模型安全的路径级干预。

title.en: Where Culture Fades: Revealing the Cultural Gap in Text-to-Image Generation
title.zh: 文化在哪里消退？揭示文生图中的文化差距

summary.en: Examine cultural gaps in text-to-image generation and their relationship to latent cultural knowledge.
summary.zh: 分析文生图模型中的文化差距，探索其与潜在文化知识之间的联系。
